honestyStatement: This shortlist reuses the existing BTL prospect packet and was not live-browser reverified in this cycle. It selects candidates for owner review only; it does not contact anyone, create CRM records, invoice, request payment, mark paid, publish or deploy.

shortlist.candidate: סמרה ושות' משרד עורכי דין ונוטריון
shortlist.apparent_focus: תביעות ביטוח לאומי, ועדות רפואיות, דיני המוסד לביטוח לאומי
shortlist.evidence_summary: Source says the office has 25+ years in BTL law and handles the medical-committee environment.
shortlist.recommended_offer: Pro 349 ILS/month incl. VAT by manual invoice
shortlist.buyer_angle: Established BTL signal; Pro can be framed as a measured profile test before higher exposure plans.
shortlist.first_private_check: Verify license, active status, BTL fit, billing email and permission for a no-PII commercial conversation.

shortlist.apparent_focus: ביטוח לאומי, ועדות רפואיות, ועדות ערר, בית הדין לעבודה
shortlist.evidence_summary: Source says the office accompanies BTL medical committees, appeals committees and labor-court proceedings; strong BTL-specific positioning.
shortlist.recommended_offer: Pro 349 ILS/month incl. VAT by manual invoice
shortlist.buyer_angle: Strong BTL positioning with broader court/appeal continuation; use Pro first to avoid overpromising lead volume.
shortlist.first_private_check: Verify license, active status, BTL fit, billing email and permission for a no-PII commercial conversation.

shortlist.apparent_focus: ערעור ועדה רפואית, נפגעי עבודה, נכות כללית, ועדות ערר
shortlist.evidence_summary: Article is specifically about ערעור על ועדה רפואית בביטוח לאומי and explains 30/60 day appeal windows and risk of reduced percentages.
shortlist.recommended_offer: Pro 349 ILS/month incl. VAT by manual invoice
shortlist.buyer_angle: Specific appeal-content signal; good for fit review, but not a first contact until license and commercial terms are verified.
shortlist.first_private_check: Verify license, active status, BTL fit, billing email and permission for a no-PII commercial conversation.

shortlist.apparent_focus: תביעות מול ביטוח לאומי, ועדות רפואיות, ועדות ערר, בית הדין האזורי לעבודה
shortlist.evidence_summary: Source describes representation in BTL disability and incapacity claims, medical committees, appeal committees and regional labor court proceedings.
shortlist.recommended_offer: Pro 349 ILS/month incl. VAT by manual invoice
shortlist.buyer_angle: Strong BTL positioning with broader court/appeal continuation; use Pro first to avoid overpromising lead volume.
shortlist.first_private_check: Verify license, active status, BTL fit, billing email and permission for a no-PII commercial conversation.

shortlist.apparent_focus: ביטוח לאומי, נכות כללית, נכות מעבודה, סיעוד, ועדות/ערעורים
shortlist.evidence_summary: Site lists ביטוח לאומי services including נכות כללית, שירותים מיוחדים, דמי פגיעה, נכות מעבודה, ילד נכה and appeals/claims language.
shortlist.recommended_offer: Pro 349 ILS/month incl. VAT by manual invoice
shortlist.buyer_angle: Relevant BTL signal; use only after owner-approved private verification.
shortlist.first_private_check: Verify license, active status, BTL fit, billing email and permission for a no-PII commercial conversation.

shortlist.candidate: לב-טייב משרד עורכי דין / עו"ד מיכאל לב
shortlist.apparent_focus: ועדה רפואית וערעור, ביטוח לאומי, תביעות ביטוח
shortlist.evidence_summary: Source says the firm has worked מול ביטוח לאומי and medical committees since 2010, and the attorney specializes in insurance claims.
shortlist.recommended_offer: Pro 349 ILS/month incl. VAT by manual invoice
shortlist.buyer_angle: Specific appeal-content signal; good for fit review, but not a first contact until license and commercial terms are verified.
shortlist.first_private_check: Verify license, active status, BTL fit, billing email and permission for a no-PII commercial conversation.
